name: Ursa Major
source:
Esther spends most of her time on her phone, texting her online girlfriend. Nobody needs to know about them. But with every day, her paranoia deepens; what if her mother finds out? Or her friends? Reality and delusion blend together as Esther struggles to tell them apart.

Do you watch the sky, Esther? Or is the sky watching you?

[From [url=https://doksa.itch.io/ursa-major]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾丝特几乎整天都抱着手机，和自己的网恋女友互发消息。她们的关系不需要让任何人知道。然而日复一日，她的多疑与偏执愈发深重：要是被妈妈发现了怎么办？要是被朋友们知道了怎么办？现实与妄想渐渐交融模糊，令艾丝特再难分清彼此。

你在仰望星空吗，艾丝特？还是说，星空正在凝视着你？

[摘自[url=https://doksa.itch.io/ursa-major]itch.io[/url]]
